// refactor: 4:14-4:22
import * as X from "effect"

export const MyStruct_ = X.Schema.Struct({
  id: X.Schema.Number,
  name: X.Schema.String
})
export interface MyStruct extends X.Schema.Schema.Type<typeof MyStruct_> { }
export interface MyStructEncoded extends X.Schema.Codec.Encoded<typeof MyStruct_> { }
export type MyStructDecodingServices = X.Schema.Codec.DecodingServices<typeof MyStruct_>;
export type MyStructEncodingServices = X.Schema.Codec.EncodingServices<typeof MyStruct_>;
export const MyStruct: X.Schema.Codec<MyStruct, MyStructEncoded, MyStructDecodingServices, MyStructEncodingServices> = MyStruct_;


=== [R1] Refactor 4: "Make Schema opaque with namespace" ===

--- file:///.src/makeSchemaOpaque_barrelNamespace.ts ---
// refactor: 4:14-4:22
import * as X from "effect"

export const MyStruct_ = X.Schema.Struct({
  id: X.Schema.Number,
  name: X.Schema.String
})
export interface MyStruct extends X.Schema.Schema.Type<typeof MyStruct_> { }
export namespace MyStruct {
    export interface Encoded extends X.Schema.Codec.Encoded<typeof MyStruct_> { }
    export type DecodingServices = X.Schema.Codec.DecodingServices<typeof MyStruct_>;
    export type EncodingServices = X.Schema.Codec.EncodingServices<typeof MyStruct_>;
}
export const MyStruct: X.Schema.Schema<MyStruct, MyStruct.Encoded, MyStruct.DecodingServices> = MyStruct_;
